ruling.recommended_action: Refund $5.30 to the rider's Ryde voucher (excess metered distance on the unexempted off-route segment); note the driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach on file.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 17:37–17:50 (+3.17 km, up to 1172 m off the optimal route). The rider's stop request [F9] named no location and the driver chose the store himself without prior notice [F11], so under RD-3(b) the extra distance is not exempted; the 17:33 'Ok' [F10] does not cover this route change (RD-5). No RD-4 exemption: no traffic incident [F14] and only band-4 speeds [F12][F13], which cannot exempt alone (RD-4(b)). Refund the metered overage per RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he simply went to a 7-Eleven he knew does not exempt the deviation: under RD-3(b)/RD-5 the rider consented only to a stop 'on the way', not to an unnamed store that forced a 3.17 km off-route detour.
Claim to refund the $1.08 waiting charge fails: for RydeTAXI, meter waiting time for the passenger-requested stop is legitimately charged (RD-3(c)) and is not refunded.
